Usage: prime env inspect [OPTIONS] ENV_ID [SOURCE_PATH]

  Inspect environment source without downloading the archive locally.

Positional arguments:
  ENV_ID         [required]
  [SOURCE_PATH]

Arguments:
  ENV_ID         [required]
  [SOURCE_PATH]

Options:
  -v, --version TEXT         Version to inspect  [default: latest]
  -o, --output TEXT          Output format: table or json  [default: table]
  --max-bytes INTEGER RANGE  Maximum file bytes to return when inspecting a
                             file  [default: 100000; 1<=x<=500000]
  --plain                    Use plain, terse outputs. USE THIS IF YOU ARE AI.
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.

  JSON output (--output json): . = {kind, path, version_id, entry?,
  entries[]?, content?, truncated, total_bytes?} .entry? = {name, path,
  is_directory, size?, modified_at?, content_hash?} .entries[] = {name, path,
  is_directory, size?, modified_at?, content_hash?}
